Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns regarding your recent behavior in the workplace. We have received multiple complaints indicating that your conduct has not aligned with our company’s values and professional standards.

We value your contributions to the team and believe in giving you the opportunity to correct this behavior. We expect to see an immediate and sustained improvement in your interactions with colleagues and adherence to our code of conduct.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this matter further or if there are any underlying issues we can help resolve.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
